verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Conductor as a closed-source Mac app that creates local git worktrees, with cloud workspaces, the API and the MCP server all hosted by the vendor. Installing a desktop client is related but is not self-hosting: nothing documents deploying Conductor's own service or cloud layer on user-controlled infrastructure, and a community comment contrasts it with an open-source alternative.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
